title: Design System: AI 토큰 사용량 대시보드

ground.purpose: Page background and sticky top bar (dark default).

surface.purpose: Every panel, drawer and sticky table header.

line.purpose: Row rules, tracks, gridlines, divider inside panels.

line-strong.purpose: Panel borders, control borders, table header rule.

ink-2.purpose: Supporting values, prompt text, default gauge fill.

focus.purpose: Focus rings, carets, selection, row and flash tints.

heat-2.purpose: Fixed model-family identity color (FAMILY_COLOR in app.js), identical in every chart, legend and theme.

display.purpose: The 지금 numeral only; one per page, weight 300, 72px (60px under 400px).

brand.purpose: Product name in the top bar (18px/600; 17px on mobile).

body-dense.purpose: Tables, buttons, chips toolbar, model rows (13px).

label.purpose: Notes, axes, legends, table headers, metadata (12px).

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system is flat; separation is fill plus 1px strong border.

shadows.name: drawer-scrim
shadows.purpose: Overlay behind the session drawer (a scrim, not a shadow).

motion.name: value-flash
motion.purpose: Brief highlight when a value increases.

motion.name: drawer-slide
motion.purpose: Session drawer entry from the right.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animations and the drawer transition set to none

themes.light: prefers-color-scheme: light unless data-theme="dark"; forced by ?theme=light|dark via data-theme on <html>

components.name: Panel
components.description: Filled panel with a strong 1px edge and a heading row (title left, muted note right). Every section is one.
components.css: .ds-panel{background:var(--surface,#1a1a1a);border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#3d3d3d);border-radius:10px;padding:20px;color:var(--ink,#ececec);font-family:var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:14px}.ds-ph{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}.ds-ph h2{margin:0;font-size:15px;font-weight:600}.ds-ph span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#9e9e9e)}.ds-panel p{margin:0}

components.name: 지금 reading
components.description: 72px weight-300 numeral, comparison line, family split bar, hairline-ruled fact rows. Mint only on the running count.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-now{background:var(--surface,#1a1a1a);border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#3d3d3d);border-radius:10px;padding:20px;color:var(--ink,#ececec);font-family:var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;max-width:340px}.ds-now h2{margin:0;font-size:15px;font-weight:600}.ds-big{font-family:"Segoe UI Variable Display","Segoe UI Light","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:72px;font-weight:300;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:4px 0 12px}.ds-cap{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted,#9e9e9e)}.ds-ratio{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-2,#bdbdbd);margin-top:4px}.ds-split{display:flex;gap:2px;height:6px;margin-top:18px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}.ds-split i{display:block;min-width:2px;border-radius:3px}.ds-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#2c2c2c);font-size:14px}.ds-row:first-of-type{margin-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#2c2c2c)}.ds-row span{color:var(--ink-2,#bdbdbd)}.ds-row b{font-weight:600}.ds-row:first-of-type b{color:var(--live,#5be3c0)}

components.name: Heat grid
components.description: Contribution-graph cells: 13px tall, 2px radius, 3px gap, five neutral brightness steps plus level 0. Brightness only; no hue.
components.html: 적음많음
components.css: .ds-hleg{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:12px var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);color:var(--muted,#9e9e9e);margin-bottom:12px}.ds-sws{display:inline-flex;gap:4px}.ds-sws i{display:block;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:2px}.ds-cells{display:flex;gap:3px}.ds-cells i{display:block;width:18px;height:13px;border-radius:2px}.ds-cells i:hover{outline:1px solid var(--ink,#ececec)}.l0{background:var(--heat-0,#222)}.l1{background:var(--heat-1,#3a3a3a)}.l2{background:var(--heat-2,#5c5c5c)}.l3{background:var(--heat-3,#8f8f8f)}.l4{background:var(--heat-4,#c8c8c8)}.l5{background:var(--heat-5,#f0f0f0)}

components.name: Provider toggle
components.description: Pill segmented control in the top bar (Claude / GPT / 전체); pressed segment takes the quiet rule fill. Shown only when both providers exist.
components.css: .ds-seg{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;padding:3px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#3d3d3d);border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface,#1a1a1a)}.ds-seg button{font:13px/18px var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);padding:4px 14px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#9e9e9e);cursor:pointer}.ds-seg button:hover{color:var(--ink,#ececec)}.ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--line,#2c2c2c);color:var(--ink,#ececec);font-weight:600}.ds-seg button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#b5b5b5);outline-offset:1px}

components.name: Filter chips
components.description: Session filters; pill, strong 1px edge; active takes the quiet rule fill and weight 600.
components.css: .ds-chips{display:flex;gap:6px}.ds-chip{font:12px/18px var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);color:var(--ink-2,#bdbdbd);background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#3d3d3d);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 12px;cursor:pointer}.ds-chip:hover{background:var(--surface-2,#222);color:var(--ink,#ececec)}.ds-chip.active{background:var(--line,#2c2c2c);color:var(--ink,#ececec);font-weight:600}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#b5b5b5);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Search field
components.description: Sessions search, 34px tall, 8px radius, ground-colored fill inside a panel.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" type="search" placeholder="제목, 프로젝트, 모델, 경로 검색">
components.css: .ds-search{width:300px;max-width:100%;height:34px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#3d3d3d);border-radius:8px;background:var(--ground,#121212);color:var(--ink,#ececec);font:13px var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);outline:0}.ds-search::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#9e9e9e);opacity:1}.ds-search:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#b5b5b5);outline-offset:1px}

components.name: Sort header
components.description: Table header button with the chevron to the LEFT of the label; chevron 45% opacity at rest, full ink when sorted.
components.css: .ds-th button{display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;background:none;border:0;padding:0 0 9px;color:var(--muted,#9e9e9e);font:500 12px var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-strong,#3d3d3d)}.ds-th button:hover{color:var(--ink,#ececec)}.ds-th svg{opacity:.45}.ds-th button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#b5b5b5);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Status badges
components.description: 작업 중 (mint filled dot, slow opacity pulse), 대기 (hollow ring, muted), 종료 (small bordered label, no dot).
components.html: 작업 중대기종료
components.css: .ds-badges{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center}.ds-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font:500 13px var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);color:var(--ink-2,#bdbdbd)}.ds-badge i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}.busy{color:var(--live,#5be3c0)}.busy i{animation:ds-pulse 3.6s ease-in-out infinite}.idle{color:var(--muted,#9e9e9e)}.idle i{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid currentColor}.ended{font-size:11px;line-height:16px;font-weight:400;border:1px solid var(--muted,#9e9e9e);border-radius:3px;padding:0 6px}.ended i{display:none}@keyframes ds-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.45}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.busy i{animation:none}}

components.name: Advisory banner
components.description: 특보: the only amber on screen; 60% border, 11% fill over surface, full-strength 14px/600 text, pill dismiss button.
components.html: 특보 · 최근 60분 토큰 사용량이 평소의 2.4배 (119.0M)
components.css: .ds-adv{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 16px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--advisory,#ff9f43) 60%,transparent);border-radius:10px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--advisory,#ff9f43) 11%,var(--surface,#1a1a1a));color:var(--advisory,#ff9f43);font:600 14px var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-adv button{background:transparent;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--advisory,#ff9f43) 60%,transparent);color:inherit;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 12px;font:600 12px var(--font, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-adv button:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--advisory,#ff9f43) 16%,transparent)}.ds-adv button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#b5b5b5);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
Token usage is read as a work rhythm, the way a developer reads a contribution graph: when you worked with agents (30 days by 24 hours) is the picture, and the live state sits beside it in a calm 360px side column. The page refuses a row of KPI cards stacked over two charts. A dark neutral gray ground carries filled panels, each closed off by a 1px strong border and a 10px radius, with 16px gutters of ground between them. Nothing casts a shadow.

The heat grid speaks in brightness only: six neutral steps from the panel's own raised fill to near white, so the rhythm reads before any color does. Color is a short list of meanings. Mint means exactly one thing (running now), amber means exactly one thing (the 특보), and the ten model-family inks are a fixed legend that appears only in bars, split strips and dots. Everything else is gray ink on gray fill. One large, light numeral (지금, the last 60 minutes) is the reading; tabular figures keep every other number aligned.

Built to stay open all day: no blur, no gradients, no icon fonts, system fonts only. Motion is a slow opacity pulse on the 작업 중 dot, a 0.6s value flash and a 0.2s drawer slide, all disabled under reduced motion. Dark is the default; the light theme is the same grays inverted, not a different world.
keyCharacteristics: Dark neutral gray ground (#121212, never blue-tinted) with clearly separated filled panels.
Contribution-graph form: daily stacked strip aligned above a day-by-hour heat grid sharing one column axis.
Heat in brightness only; mint for running now; amber for the 특보; fixed model inks.
No shadows, no current-time marker on the 48-hour chart, nothing heavy.
Table sort arrows sit left of header labels.

rules.name: The Brightness-Only Heat Rule
rules.body: The heat grid and its legend use only the neutral ramp. No hue, no model ink, no mint, no amber in a heat cell, ever.

rules.name: The Reserved Mint Rule
rules.body: Mint appears only where something is running now. If nothing is running, no mint is on screen.

rules.name: The Advisory-Only Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber is spent only on the 특보 banner. It is never a warning color, a hover color or an accent.

rules.name: The Fixed Inks Rule
rules.body: A model family has one ink everywhere. Provider badges (Claude / GPT) stay neutral ink on a strong border so they never compete with model inks.

rules.name: The Light Reading Rule
rules.body: The headline number is large and light (weight 300), never bold. Size carries the reading; weight goes to headings.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change lines up: tabular numerals everywhere, right-aligned in tables and fact lists.

rules.name: The Separated Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels are unmistakably separate: fill, strong border, radius and a gutter of ground, never shadows. A new section is a new panel with a heading row, not a divider inside an existing one.

dos: **Do** put every new section in a panel: `surface` fill, 1px `line-strong` border, 10px radius, 20px padding, heading row.
**Do** render any frequency or intensity as the neutral heat ramp (`heat-0` to `heat-5`), brightness only.
**Do** keep mint for running-now signals and amber for the 특보 only.
**Do** take model colors from `FAMILY_COLOR`; the same family is the same ink in every chart, legend and dot, in both themes.
**Do** use tabular numerals and right-align numbers in tables and fact lists.
**Do** place sort chevrons to the left of header labels in every sortable table.
**Do** define colors as custom properties with dark default and light values, honoring `prefers-color-scheme`, `data-theme` and `?theme=light|dark`.
**Do** keep motion to the dot pulse, the value flash and the drawer slide, and switch it off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: **Don't** tint the ground or panels blue; grays stay neutral.
**Don't** add box-shadows, gradients, blur or any effect that costs CPU or GPU in an always-open tab.
**Don't** add a "지금" marker or current-hour highlight to the 48-hour chart.
**Don't** use mint or amber as generic accents, hover colors or brand color, and never inside the heat grid.
**Don't** recolor a model family per chart or theme, or tint provider badges with model inks.
**Don't** load web fonts, icon fonts or CDN assets; the stack is system fonts only.
**Don't** bold the 지금 reading; it stays at weight 300.
**Don't** let the page scroll horizontally; hide table columns in order instead.
